_about: The branch of Thomas Kastl, one of the seven brothers. See docs/EXTRACTION.md.

sources.quote: Thomas Kastl was born 4 January 1850 in Vsepadly, Bohemia, house No. 11

facts.value: Arrived at Baltimore 29 May 1867 with his brother Andrew, on the Johannes–Wilhelmina, from Bremen

sources.quote: young Thomas and Andrew came to the United States, sailing from Bremen, Germany on the S.S Johannes—Wilhelmina, arriving at the Port of Baltimore on 29 May 1867.
In 1873, Thomas married Augusta Johns in Champaign.

facts.value: (2) Emma Fowler of Meredosia, Illinois, 21 February 1886

sources.quote: Thomas married Emma Fowler of Meredosia, Illinois on 21 February 1886.
Wenzel at Omaha, and Thomas in Illinois.

facts.value: Settled in Champaign, Illinois, where he had a buggy factory. Had 8 children; no surviving descendants.

sources.quote: Thomas eventually settled in Champaign, Illinois, where he had a buggy factory.
Although Thomas had 8 children, there are no surviving descendants.
